python3 << 'EOF'
import statistics

# Monthly net excise taxes for FY 2018 (in millions)
values = [7463, 7240, 6867, 6168, 5878, 7849, 6905, 7325, 7343, 7716, 8154, 16079]

# Calculate Mean Absolute Deviation
mean = statistics.mean(values)
print(f"Mean: {mean}")

# Calculate absolute deviations
abs_deviations = [abs(x - mean) for x in values]
print(f"Values: {values}")
print(f"Absolute deviations: {abs_deviations}")

# Calculate MAD
mad = statistics.mean(abs_deviations)
print(f"\nMean Absolute Deviation (MAD): {mad}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {mad:.3f}")
EOF
